meta.title: Lantai core memory
meta.description: Load Lantai core memory for explicitly bound DSH conversations authorized by the Host owner. Disabled by default. Read policy and identity, with optional task memory, over HTTPS, explicitly allowed loopback HTTP, or strictly verified SSH. Models cannot grant access. Each conversation needs the user's interface action. Data enters model requests and chat history; stopping access does not delete existing history.

client.groupLabel: Lantai memory access for this conversation
client.allowDetail: Allow this conversation to read the configured Lantai user policies and profile
client.stopDetail: Stop further reads; content already in chat history remains
client.unavailable: The connection needs checking. Ask the assistant to continue setup.
client.noAgent: Send one message in this conversation, then allow memory.
client.notBound: Memory is not configured for this folder.
client.identityMismatch: Memory ownership needs checking; nothing was loaded.
client.stopUnconfirmed: Stopping is not confirmed. Press Stop to retry.
client.hint: Permission applies only to this conversation. The configured user policies and profile will be sent to its model. Stopping access does not delete chat history.
